heroSubtitle: One place for Bangladeshi developers to learn, build, share and grow together.
whatIsBody: BSDC is a community platform for people who build software in Bangladesh and for Bangladesh. It brings discussion, learning, freelancing, hiring, local commerce and events into one place that belongs to the community itself.

communityFirst.title: Community first
communityFirst.body: Members decide what matters. Product decisions are published, not hidden.

transparent.title: Transparent by default
transparent.body: Rules, moderation and platform changes are documented in public.

local.title: Built for Bangladesh
local.body: Bangla and English are both first-class. Payments, logistics and support are local.

merit.title: Merit over noise
merit.body: Ranking rewards substance, consistency and real contribution.

feed.title: Community feed
feed.body: Posts, questions, polls, code and long-form writing with reactions and comments.

groups.title: Groups
groups.body: Public, private and secret groups with roles, rules and moderation.

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.body: Verified vendors sell to members with escrow-free, dispute-tracked orders.

jobs.title: Jobs and hiring
jobs.body: Post and apply for roles with a plain, honest application flow.

events.title: Events and meetups
events.body: Online and in-person events with registration and attendance.

messaging.title: Messaging
messaging.body: Direct and group chat with presence, typing and delivery receipts.

networkBody: BSDC runs inside a single Bangladeshi ecosystem: learning, cloud, news, knowledge and open source, all under one roof.
ctaBody: BSDC is being built in the open. Read the plan, follow the progress, and hold us to it.
